text:
marco: Quick heads-up — we need to coordinate GCP SEA (asia-southeast1) marketplace SKU + quota request for partner launch target 2026-05-15. Need capacity numbers and legal sign-off by EOW.

sai: Thanks, marco. Can you paste the expected QPS and peak concurrent GPUs? I can file the marketplace entitlement once we have that.

marco: Target QPS 200 req/s, burst 400 for first 3 months. Peak concurrent GPU nodes: 12 A10G-equivalents (we'll prefer mixture A100 for inference-heavy). Estimate total vCPU/GPU SKU units: 12 GPUs + 48 vCPUs.

tom: For infra, 12 A10G is OK for Dedicated early — need to confirm if partner-managed capacity or our Dedicated pools. If marketplace is used for pay-as-you-go, we'll need a fallback routing plan.

sai: Partner asked for marketplace SKU name. Proposed: redwood-inference-asia-southeast1. Is that final?

marco: Let's use redwood-inference-sea1 for short. Update: please file quota request with GCP portal and cc @lisa for legal.

lisa: Legal notes — must attach DPA addendum + SOC2 Type II attestation before public listing. I can sign a marketplace addendum but need the procurement contacts and expected revenue band for contract terms.

jenna: Marketing/PR — we want a joint announcement w/ partner. Can we lock launch date? Ops said target 2026-05-15 but legal suggests extra lead time. Suggest soft-launch 2026-05-22 if legal finishes.

sai: Filed initial entitlement ticket: https://partner-console.gcp.example/ticket/PRT-7890 (partner console link). Marketplace team replied: quota approval turnaround ~7 business days once submitted.

deploy-bot: Created internal ticket: PRJ-4321 — 'SEA marketplace capacity + legal checklist' assigned to tom, lisa, sai.

tom: I'll run a quick capacity validation script in staging and post numbers by tomorrow. snippet:
```
# estimate
python tools/capacity_estimator.py --region asia-southeast1 --gpus 12 --seq 512
```

marco: Great — action items: sai -> submit marketplace quota + SKU, lisa -> DPA/SOC check, tom -> capacity validation, jenna -> draft announcement timeline. Update here when tickets change :thumbsup:
